verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs describe filesystems as high-capacity regional file stores you attach to instances to hold datasets and back up system state. An S3-compatible adapter (rclone/s5cmd) lets you move data in and out independently of instances, and MK8s adds shared persistent storage across 1CC nodes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that a filesystem persists after its instance is terminated, details on attach/detach and lifecycle, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
